:::{#exm-deriv-normsq}

#### Derivative of a sum of squares

Let $\vb = \tp{(\beta_1, \beta_2)}$, so $\tp{\vb}\vb = \beta_1^2 + \beta_2^2$.
By @cor-deriv-normsq:

$$
\underbrace{\deriv{\vb}(\tp{\vb}\vb)}_{2 \times 1}
= 2\vb
= \begin{pmatrix} 2\beta_1 \\ 2\beta_2 \end{pmatrix}
$$

Direct partial differentiation yields the same column vector.

:::
